title: 2026/2027 Chinese Government Scholarship - China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program
official_source: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the Republic of Indonesia
program_type: China - Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program
duration: Undergraduate: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-3 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years
description: The Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the Republic of Indonesia opened the 2026/2027 Chinese Government Scholarship, which includes the China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program with 20 places for undergraduate, master's and doctoral study in China. The award is described as a full scholarship but explicitly does not include international travel expenses. Applicants apply online through the China Scholarship Council system at www.campuschina.org using Indonesian agency number 3602, and no paper materials are sent to the Embassy.

title: Czech Government Scholarship - Developing Countries (AY 2027/28), Charles University Faculty of Social Sciences
official_source: Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports of the Czech Republic (Government of the Czech Republic scholarship, administered by DZS)
program_type: Czech Government Scholarship - Developing Countries, hosted at the Charles University Faculty of Social Sciences
duration: Standard period of study (typically 2 years for Master's, 3-4 years for Doctoral)

title: Václav Havel Bursary - Charles University
degree: Any degree programme at a Charles University faculty (undergraduate, master's or doctoral)
program_type: University hardship bursary for students affected by repression and violation of human rights, governed by Rector's Directive No. 56/2025

Students from countries where humanitarian organisations report violated human rights and freedoms and where discriminatory measures restrict access to education may apply, provided they have already been admitted and enrolled in a degree programme at a Charles University faculty through the standard admissions procedure. title: Visegrad Scholarship Program 2027
program_type: Regional mobility scholarship for Master's and post-Master's students and researchers
duration: 1-2 semesters (up to 4 semesters for BA/MA scholars)
description: The Visegrad Scholarship Program supports full-time Master's and post-Master's students and researchers in all disciplines and in any language for one to two semesters at more than 190 accredited higher-education institutions across Central and Eastern Europe. It is funded by the International Visegrad Fund, founded by the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia. The award is EUR 3,500 per semester for the scholar plus EUR 2,000 per semester for the host institution, and it does not cover tuition. program_type: University scholarship for foreign students on Master's and doctoral study programmes under Act No. 111/1998 Sb. on Universities, section 91(3)(b)
duration: 1-2 semesters initially, extendable to full Master's programme duration

program_type: Danish Government Scholarship for full degree students (tuition waiver and/or living grant)
